problems.noProject: A session with No project cannot move.
problems.noGit: The session’s folder is not in a Git repository.
problems.noCommits: The repository has no commit yet.
problems.operation: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert is under way in the repository. Finish or abort it first.
problems.tooLarge: What would be sent is over 512 MB, which is too large.
problems.noRemote: That computer has no such project, and the repository has no remote it could clone.
problems.agentMissing: That computer has no {{agent}}. Add it there first.
problems.agentOff: {{agent}} is turned off on that computer. Turn it on there first.
problems.agentNotInstalled: {{agent}} is not installed on that computer yet. Install it there first.
problems.signedOut: {{agent}} is signed out on that computer. Sign in there first.
problems.sameHost: The session is on that computer already.
problems.offline: That computer is not connected now.
problems.olderHost: Kite on that computer is too old to take sessions. Update it first.
problems.sameProject: The session is in this project already.
problems.worktree: The session works in a worktree of its repository, whose work a move into another repository would leave behind. Merge or clean up the worktree first.

notes.ignoredFiles: Files .gitignore leaves out, such as .env and node_modules, stay behind.
notes.submodules: Submodules come as the commits they point at; update them there.
notes.lfs: Git LFS files come as pointers; that computer fetches them from the LFS server.
notes.signInUnknown: Whether {{agent}} is signed in there is not known yet; if not, the first message asks you to sign in.
notes.carry: This agent’s own history cannot move, so Kite hands it the conversation it kept.

steps.pack: Pack the branch, changes and conversation

local.title: Move to another project
local.into: Into the project {{name}} on this computer.
local.code: Code: the session’s files and changes stay in its old project
local.worktree: A new worktree in {{name}}, leaving its own folder alone
local.resume: Conversation: {{agent}} goes on from its own history in the new project
local.carry: Conversation: {{agent}} goes on from Kite’s copy of it in the new project
local.here: The old session is archived, marked with where it went; the old project’s files stay as they are.
local.moved: This session moved to the project {{name}} and goes on there. The old project’s files are as they were.
local.done: Moved to the project {{name}}. The old session is archived with where it went; the old project’s files stay as they are.

steps.check: Check the session and the project

rewind.rewindBody_one: The message after this one and its reply leave the conversation.
rewind.rewindBody_other: The {{count}} messages after this one and their replies leave the conversation.
rewind.fresh: {{agent}} can't take turns out of its own history, so a new {{agent}} session carries on from here, given the conversation so far.
rewind.empty: Nothing of the conversation is left, so the next message starts a new {{agent}} session.
rewind.filesUnchanged: The files are as they were then.
rewind.filesNone: No copy of the files was kept at this message.
rewind.filesBusy: “{{session}}” is working in these files. Restore them once it's done.
rewind.kept_one: {{count}} more changed file wasn't saved then, so it stays as it is.
rewind.kept_other: {{count}} more changed files weren't saved then, so they stay as they are.
rewind.overwrite: Changes you made yourself since then are undone too. Kite keeps a copy of the files as they are now, so you can undo the restore.
rewind.undoneFiles: The files are back as they were before the restore
rewind.filesLater: Files can be put back once the running turn ends.

zen.findShowsAll: Find shows every step while it is open.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.subtitle: {{agent}} · {{title}}
mcp.notRunning: {{agent}} isn't running for this session. Its MCP servers start with the next message.
mcp.notRunningStart: {{agent}} isn't running for this session. Start it to see the servers it connects.
mcp.notReported: {{agent}} doesn't report the state of its MCP servers. These are the servers Kite gave it.
mcp.none: {{agent}} has no MCP servers in this session.
mcp.noneKnown: No servers to show until the agent starts.
mcp.disableLastingHint: {{agent}} remembers this for the project until you turn it on again.

login.inBrowser: Finish signing in in your browser. This list updates when you come back.
login.elsewhere: Sign in to it in the agent's own terminal, such as /mcp in Claude Code.

apps.title: ChatGPT apps
apps.none: This ChatGPT account has no apps connected.

reload.hint: Newly installed skills and plugins apply to this session without restarting it
reload.busy: The agent is at work. Reload once its turn ends.
reload.unsupported: This agent can't reload without restarting
reload.busySome_one: {{count}} at work, reload it after its turn
reload.busySome_other: {{count}} at work, reload them after their turns
